expressions.title: The Military Court Sentences (Supplementary Provisions) Ordinance, 1962
expressions.title_basis: p1 blocks 1383339-1383341 print 'No. F. 32 (1)/62-Pub. ... ORDINANCE No. LXXVIII OF 1962 AN ORDINANCE to make certain provisions relating to sentences passed by the Military Courts constituted under Martial Law Regulations'; s.1(1) (block 1383348) names it the Military Court Sentences (Supplementary Provisions) Ordinance, 1962; complete to the signatures on p2 (blocks 1383359-1383360) and the imprint (block 1383363). Blocks 1383330-1383338 (p1) are the tail of ORDINANCE No. LXXVII of 1962 (ss.2-3 and signatures; the Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962), which began before this PDF -- a fragment, set aside as apparatus; that Ordinance is printed complete in document 8116 (owner policy q1 'split').
